item.title: Exploring SOCKS5 the Fundation of Advanced Proxy Protocols for Internet Censorship Circumvention
item.description:
The SOCKS5 protocol serves as a foundational proxy protocol that has inspired the development of more advanced solutions for secure communications, privacy enhancement, and internet censorship circumvention. These issues are particularly pressing in countries like Islamic Republic of Iran, China, India, and Kazakhstan.

In this blog, we delve into SOCKS5’s usage, technical specifications, limitations, and how it has influenced the development of subsequent proxy protocols.

1. Introduction

The SOCKS5 protocol has emerged as a crucial foundation for more advanced proxy solutions. While SOCKS5 itself has limitations, its core principles and structure have inspired the development of sophisticated tools for enhancing privacy, securing online communications, and bypassing internet censorship. In this blog we’re not going to cover that why Internet censorship is bad, I’ll try to keep this blog as technical as possible.
